name: momentum_ignition_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY consolidates for 15-20 minutes within a 20-40 spot point range, intraday bracket-order traders and mean-reversion algos accumulate positions near both boundaries with stops clustered just outside. A breakout bar with 2.5x+ volume surge vs the preceding 5-minute baseline signals large institutional order flow overwhelming the range ceiling or floor. This triggers sequential stop-loss cascades from trapped traders in the next 30-90 seconds, pushing NIFTY an additional 20-35 spot points beyond the breakout level. At 5-second resolution we enter on the ignition bar itself — before most momentum algos have confirmed and joined — capturing the first 15-20 spot points of the cascade.
core_signal_oneliner: 20-minute range breakout with 2.5x volume surge and strong bar close position, triggering cascading stop-loss execution from trapped range participants
